# coverage-via-covers-relationship

coverage_for determines tests covering a component by selecting EntityRow rows joined through RelationshipRow entries where relation_type == 'covers' and RelationshipRow.to_entity_id == component.id.

Use explicit 'covers' relationships in the graph database as the authoritative link from tests to the component they exercise.
